subject: Private deployment maintenance window co-authoring & emergency unpin procedure
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment maintenance window co-authoring & emergency unpin procedure

Sanjay —

Following up on our onboarding call last week. We'd like to schedule the private deployment maintenance for your VPC (pinned version -> patch upgrade) and want to co-author the maintenance window with AcmeHealth ops so we minimize customer-facing risk. Proposed slot: Friday 2026-08-28 02:00–05:00 PDT (narrow window) with a canary slice for 30 minutes prior to full cutover.

Key asks for your team:
- Confirm CAB approval path (time + attendee list).
- Confirm whether the proposed window conflicts with your nightly backups or regulatory jobs.
- Confirm whether your ops team needs a dry-run / staging rehearsal this week.

Rollback & unpin expectations (high level):
- We plan to pin traffic to the pre-upgrade variant at the start of the window and run a canary. If regression is detected, we will trigger an unpin and immediate rollback to the pinned model binary.
- We anticipate an unpin + restore time of ~12–18 minutes (includes KV cache warmdown and routing switch).

I've attached a maintenance matrix that lists components, contact on-call, and the rollback checklist reference. Neha / Karthik — would appreciate any adjustments to the rollback timing estimates or escape criteria.

Attachments: maint-matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Lukas
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private deployment maintenance window co-authoring & emergency unpin procedure

Lukas —

Thanks for the proposed slot. Two quick items from our side: we have a nightly ETL that runs until ~02:30 PDT; if you can start at 03:00 PDT that'd be safer for us.

About the unpin: can you confirm whether the unpin is a network-only routing change (i.e., no instance reboots) or if your rollback requires draining nodes and restarting services? Our CAB will want the exact sequence for the SOP.

Also need to know who from Redwood will be on the CAB bridge and the point person for post-change telemetry review.

If you can send a short SOP we can attach to our CAB request.

—Sanjay
Director, Platform Ops
AcmeHealth

On Aug 15, 2026, at 11:23, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Lukas —
>
> Thanks for the proposed slot. Two quick items from our side: we have a nightly ETL that runs until ~02:30 PDT; if you can start at 03:00 PDT that'd be safer for us.
>
> About the unpin: can you confirm whether the unpin is a network-only routing change (i.e., no instance reboots) or if your rollback requires draining nodes and restarting services?

Sanjay — short answers inlined:  
- Start time: 03:00–06:00 PDT works for us (shifting the canary accordingly).
- Unpin mechanics: this is a routing-level unpin. We will switch customer routing back to the pinned model variant; the runtime is designed to avoid full node restarts for a revert.
  - Steps: (1) Quiesce new traffic; (2) flip routing to pinned variant; (3) invalidate KV prefixes that were written during the canary if necessary; (4) confirm key metrics (latency, error-rate, token-per-second) for 10 minutes.
  - Worst-case: if we see persistent correctness/regression tied to a model binary, there is a forced node recycle path, but that is a last-resort and will be done with your authorization.

I've attached the rollback check list (rollback-checklist.pdf) — it's a short SOP suitable to include in your CAB package.

On staffing: Lukas (engaging) will lead the bridge, Karthik will own routing flips and KV invalidation, Monica will watch telemetry and coordinate with your SRE during the canary.

Neha
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rollback-checklist.pdf
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment maintenance window co-authoring & emergency unpin procedure

Sanjay — thanks for the quick checks and for the ETL heads-up. 03:00–06:00 PDT on Fri 2026-08-28 is now our tentative agreed window. I'll file the change window and send the CAB blurb.

Operational details we'll include in the CAB SOP (short, bulletized):
- Pre-window: Dry-run in staging 2026-08-26 10:00–11:00 PDT (we recommend at least one rehearsal).
- Canary: 03:00–03:30 — 10% of traffic to patched variant; telemetry gating thresholds: error-rate > 2x baseline OR latency p95 increase > 30% triggers abort.
- Rollback (unpin) sequence: 
  1) Stop routing to the canary (immediate).
  2) Flip primary routing back to pinned variant via control-plane (expected < 2 minutes).
  3) Invalidate KV prefixes older than canary start (if correctness concerns appear) — Karthik will run this step.
  4) Confirm system health for 10 minutes before closing the window.
- Worst-case node recycle: requires mutual consent, estimated 12–25 minutes to fully reconverge.

I'll attach the CAB blurb and a light runbook to the Hub link and share the DocID with you in the next email. On the day of the change, our bridge: Lukas (lead), Karthik (routing), Monica (telemetry), Neha (incident escalation). Please confirm who from AcmeHealth will be on the bridge and which PagerDuty channel to monitor.

Links: https://redwood-internal.company/drive/Private-Maintenance-Plan-ACME-342

Thanks — looking forward to the dry-run rehearsal.
Lukas
